simple.meaning: נָבִיא (nâbîyʼ) appears 317 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a brother in the family line and in connection with prophetic witness.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Genesis, Exodus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, Judges, and 4 more, beginning at Genesis 20:7. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family, family line, commandment, prophetic witness.
